product_media_deletion_reason_check.name: product_media_deletion_reason_check
product_media_deletion_reason_check.value: "catalog"."product_media"."deletion_reason" is null or ("catalog"."product_media"."deletion_reason" = btrim("catalog"."product_media"."deletion_reason") and length("catalog"."product_media"."deletion_reason") between 3 and 500)

product_variant_fields_nonempty_check.name: product_variant_fields_nonempty_check
product_variant_fields_nonempty_check.value: "catalog"."product_variant"."sku" = btrim("catalog"."product_variant"."sku") AND length("catalog"."product_variant"."sku") > 0 AND "catalog"."product_variant"."color" = btrim("catalog"."product_variant"."color") AND length("catalog"."product_variant"."color") > 0 AND "catalog"."product_variant"."size_label" = btrim("catalog"."product_variant"."size_label") AND length("catalog"."product_variant"."size_label") > 0

location_parent_shape_check.name: location_parent_shape_check
location_parent_shape_check.value: ("geography"."location"."level" = 'division' and "geography"."location"."parent_id" is null) or ("geography"."location"."level" in ('district', 'upazila') and "geography"."location"."parent_id" is not null)

snapshot_authority_check.name: snapshot_authority_check
snapshot_authority_check.value: "geography"."snapshot"."authority" in ('Bangladesh National Portal', 'Bangladesh National Portal and Bangladesh Government Press (Cabinet Division)')

profile_product_tax_rule_check.name: profile_product_tax_rule_check
profile_product_tax_rule_check.value: ("tax"."profile"."product_treatment" = 'taxable' and "tax"."profile"."product_rate_numerator" between 1 and 1000000000 and "tax"."profile"."product_rate_denominator" between 1 and 1000000000) or ("tax"."profile"."product_treatment" = 'exempt' and "tax"."profile"."product_rate_numerator" is null and "tax"."profile"."product_rate_denominator" is null)

profile_delivery_tax_rule_check.name: profile_delivery_tax_rule_check
profile_delivery_tax_rule_check.value: ("tax"."profile"."delivery_treatment" = 'taxable' and "tax"."profile"."delivery_rate_numerator" between 1 and 1000000000 and "tax"."profile"."delivery_rate_denominator" between 1 and 1000000000) or ("tax"."profile"."delivery_treatment" = 'exempt' and "tax"."profile"."delivery_rate_numerator" is null and "tax"."profile"."delivery_rate_denominator" is null)

profile_source_check.name: profile_source_check
profile_source_check.value: "tax"."profile"."source_reference" = btrim("tax"."profile"."source_reference") and length("tax"."profile"."source_reference") between 1 and 500 and "tax"."profile"."source_version" = btrim("tax"."profile"."source_version") and length("tax"."profile"."source_version") between 1 and 120

snapshot_owner_check.name: snapshot_owner_check
snapshot_owner_check.value: ("quote"."snapshot"."customer_id" is not null and "quote"."snapshot"."guest_cart_hash" is null) or ("quote"."snapshot"."customer_id" is null and "quote"."snapshot"."guest_cart_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

snapshot_amount_check.name: snapshot_amount_check
snapshot_amount_check.value: "quote"."snapshot"."delivery_amount_bdt" between 1 and 9007199254740991 and "quote"."snapshot"."merchandise_gross_bdt" between 0 and 9007199254740991 and "quote"."snapshot"."total_tax_amount_bdt" between 0 and 9007199254740991 and "quote"."snapshot"."total_bdt" between 1 and 9007199254740991 and "quote"."snapshot"."total_bdt" = "quote"."snapshot"."merchandise_gross_bdt" + "quote"."snapshot"."delivery_amount_bdt"
